subject: Taxes
title: The Whiskey Rebellion
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Whiskey Rebellion usable.

hook.text: In 1794, Pennsylvania farmers attacked federal tax collectors over whiskey taxes.

buildup.text: Alexander Hamilton imposed the whiskey tax to pay Revolutionary War debts.

discovery.text: Farmers saw the tax as favoring rich eastern distillers who could absorb costs. Small producers were crushed.

twist.text: Washington's show of force ended the rebellion without a battle.

climax.text: The Whiskey Rebellion tested whether the new republic could survive a tax revolt. The Constitution held—through force.

punchline.text: Tax whiskey, and farmers rebel. Send the president with an army.

quiz.question: Who led troops to suppress the Whiskey Rebellion?
